ZONING BOARD O F APPEA LS AND VARIANCE PROCESS Please submit this signed Variance Request Application and all necessary information to the Code Enforcement Officer at 631 S. Myrtle Ave, PO Box 367, Willard, OH 44890. The Building and Zoning Board of Appeals meets as needed. Once all of the information specified on the application has been received, a public hearing shall be scheduled. NOTICE Notice shall be given in Willard Times Junction paper and on the City of Willard's website. At least 10 days before the hearing, written notice shall be sent to all property owners within 300 feet of the location. Notice by certified mail shall be sent to all abutting property owners. If the Building and Zoning Board of Appeals approves the variance or appeal , it then moves to Council for their approval. WILLARD RESERVOIR BOAT PERMIT APPLICATION RESERVOIR B OATING REGULATIONS 1. A boating permit must be obtained from the City Service Desk (Monday – Friday, 8 am – 4:30 pm) or the Willard Police Department (after hours and weekends) before any boat shall be permitted on the Reservoir. Both locations are located at Willard City Hall, 631 S. Myrtle. 2. NO ALCOHOL, DISORDORERLY CONDUCT OR INTOXICATED BEHAVOR IS PERMITTED. 3. BOATS WITH GASOLINE MOTORS ARE PROHIBITED INCLUDING ALL LIQUID OR LIQUIFIED PETROLEU M PRODUCTS. 4. Swimming is prohibited. 5. Boats with electric motors over 3 HP are prohibited. 6. Boats shall not exceed 25 feet in length and must satisfy US Coast Guard Standards for seaworthiness. 7. All boats must carry safety equipment and life jackets, life vest s or life buoys or buoyant cushions sufficient to sustain any and all occupants afloat as prescribe by the US Coast Guard.
